repository_citation: Moro, S., Rita, P., and Cortez, P. (2014). Bank Marketing [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5K306.
original_variant_citation: Moro, S., Laureano, R., and Cortez, P. (2011). Using Data Mining for Bank Direct Marketing: An Application of the CRISP-DM Methodology. ESM 2011, pp. 117-121. EUROSIS.

extraction.note: Official archive bytes and selected extracted files are preserved unchanged. The sampled bank.csv and alternate bank-additional variant were not extracted. No source rows were reordered or transformed.

verification.method: PowerShell Import-Csv with semicolon delimiter and exact header, row-count, target, and history checks
verification.chronology_documentation: bank-names.txt states that bank-full.csv is ordered by date, May 2008 to November 2010. Original row order is preserved; the CSV has no full timestamp or customer ID for independent date/client validation.
verification.limits: Only basic integrity and schema checks were completed. Feature timing, full data quality review, split cutoff, preprocessing, and model evaluation remain pending.
